{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify rows with sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Count how many sentinel values there are
num_sentinel = sentinel_mask.sum()

# Compute mean biomarker_baseline excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df.loc[~sentinel_mask, 'biomarker_baseline'].mean()

num_sentinel, mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
